_note: ANT WORK 4 voice script. id -> {who, text}. Text in [brackets] is a stage direction and is not spoken. Render: python3 tools/voices.py

g_again.text: Don't. Move. ...You two fell outta the sky?

j_hands.text: Okay! Okay! Hands up! We're not armed!

j_talk.text: Wait, wait! We fell! We're not from here, we don't even know where here IS!

m_laugh.text: [laughs] Fell? From where, heaven? Ha! Heaven don't want you either, son.

j_moeName.text: Moe. Put it down. We'll pay for your roof.

m_howknow.text: ...Now how in the hell do you know my name?

m_job1.text: Welcome to Dry Gulch, on Dustreach. And that was MY roof. Twenty gold nuggets.

m_job1b.text: Huh. Fine. Twenty nuggets, and you'll work it off.

m_job2.text: Take this crate of whiskey to Doc Bishop. Get the money Lucky owes me. And tell the Sheriff the Riders are comin' tonight. Then we're square.

j2_job.text: Errands. We fell through a roof on another planet... and we're doing errands.

j2_where.text: Dustreach. Never heard of it. Your watch did this again, didn't it.

j_where.text: It always does. Come on. Let's not get shot.

m_job.text: Doc, Lucky, the Sheriff. Then come see me.

m_paid.text: Roof's paid. Here, a little somethin' for your trouble. Now be inside by sundown, you hear?

m_riders.text: Masked devils. They ride in every sundown and they kill whoever's out in the street. Gideon leads 'em.

m_riders2.text: [laughs] Nobody's ever seen his face. Lock your door, boys.

j_trap.text: What's under that trapdoor behind the bar?

m_trap.text: Whiskey, son. Just whiskey. Don't you go pokin' around back there.

j_tellship.text: Listen... there's a ship. Buried out past the bones. We're getting off this planet.

m_tellship.text: A ship? [laughs] Well ain't that somethin'. You be careful who you tell, now.

j_gideon.text: I know who you are... Gideon.

m_gideon.text: ...Now that was a real dumb thing to say out loud, son.

m_caught.text: Hey! Get your hands off my mirror!

j_warn.text: Sheriff? Moe says the Riders are coming tonight.

a_warn.text: Every night, son. Every single night. I got six bullets and a bad hip. Be inside by sundown.

a_gid.text: If I knew, he'd be swingin' from that water tower. Wears a mask. Laughs like a madman while he shoots.

a_gid2.text: One fella who lived said he saw gold teeth when the bastard laughed.

a_port.text: Rider country. They guard it day and night. Somethin' in that hangar they want real bad.

a_believe.text: ...Lord. That's a Rider mask. Moe's poured my whiskey for twenty years. At sundown, I'll be right beside you.

a_doubt.text: Moe? Son, you be real careful sayin' a thing like that without proof.

a_ship.text: A ship. Hm. Wish I could leave with you. Somebody's gotta stay and bury folks.

a_final.text: You boys hold that ship. I got the ones on the left!

a_lower.text: ...Lord forgive me. He said he'd kill my sister. [lowers the gun] Go on. Go.

d_crate.text: Bless you. The only medicine that works on this rock. Here, take some bandages. You'll need 'em.

d_moe.text: [hic] Moe? Heh. Moe's got a cellar nobody's ever seen. Locked tight.

d_moe2.text: Keeps the key on a nail. Behind his big mirror. [hic] You didn't hear that from me.

d_heal.text: Hold still. There. Try not to get shot again.

d_trust.text: Your secret's safe with an old drunk. Who'd believe me anyway?

j_fix.text: If we found a ship... could you fix it?

t_ship.text: A ship? If it's real, it needs three things. A power core. A fuel cell. And a nav brain.

t_ship2.text: The nav I can build. Ten gold. The core's the glowin' rock they dig in the old mine. Fuel... the spaceport. Or whatever Moe gets off that train.

t_broke.text: Ten gold. I don't work for smiles.

t_done.text: Here. Don't drop it. I only got one eye left to build another.

t_hand.text: Built it myself. The old one got bit off in the mine. Somethin' lives down there. Never saw it. Heard it breathin'. Bring a light.

t_dyn.text: Hank keeps a box in his back room. Lost the key when his brother died. Undertaker's got all the dead man's things.

t_trust.text: I'll keep my mouth shut. Only thing I do better than fixin'.

r_1.text: You! You look like folks who fell outta the sky! I KNEW it!

r_2.text: There's a ship, see. Buried south, past the giant bones. Sky-metal! But nobody believes old Rook.

j_believe.text: I believe you. Where's the ship?

r_map.text: You... you do? Ha! Here. My map. The X is the ship. Don't lose it!

j_dig.text: Can you help us dig it out?

r_dig.text: I'll dig till my arms fall off! Give me three hours!

r_moe.text: Moe? Ha! I always said that man laughs too much.

h_back.text: Dynamite. And it stays there. Lost the key when my brother died, anyhow.

h_ship.text: A ship, huh? Hope it flies better than my last mule.

o_1.text: Two of you. Same face. I'll need two boxes by morning, I reckon.

j_key.text: Hank's brother had a key in his pocket...

o_key.text: Everything a dead man owns goes in his box. Help me carry the new coffin, and you can have what's in his pockets.

o_thanks.text: Here. The key. Try not to need one of my boxes.

o_ship.text: Leaving? Good. Nobody leaves Dry Gulch. Except in a box.

l_debt.text: Moe always wants his money. Sit down, stranger. Let's talk about it.

l_scared.text: Whoa! Easy! Here! Take it! [mutters] You'll regret that.

j_ace.text: There's an ace up your sleeve.

l_ace.text: ...Huh. Sharp eyes. Tell you what. I'll pay Moe myself. Take this key, won it off a train guard. It's cursed anyway.

l_thanks.text: Well! A gentleman. Here's a free tip: the noon train carries somethin' for Moe in the caboose safe. Every day.

l_ship.text: A ship! Well now. Your secret's safe with me, partner. [grins]

p_safe.text: The bell tower. The Riders don't climb. God's house... and a good ladder.

p_ship.text: Bless you, child. I'll pray for your journey. [quietly] And I'll tell no one.

p_moe.text: Moe? ...I'll pray on that. Keep it to yourself, child.

n_room.text: Room's up the stairs. Lock the door. Don't open it for nobody.

s_1.text: We left Dry Gulch. Better the storms than the Riders.

s_2.text: Every night they come. Every night somebody's gone. Nobody remembers it's always the same.

s_bones.text: Somethin' big died out there before the town was born. Old Rook says it crashed. He's crazy. ...Probably.

g_laugh.text: Ha ha ha ha HA! Come out, come out, little strangers!

j_masks.text: Masks. Hollow Rider masks. A whole wall of them.

b_2.text: Jay?! JAY! And... TWO Jays?! What are you doing on Dustreach?!

j_bob.text: Bob?! You disappeared! We thought you were gone forever!

b_3.text: Gone? I've been stuck on this rock for years, digging glow rock for Moe. Every day. Same tunnels.

j2_bob.text: He doesn't know about the loop. He thinks he's never seen us here before.

b_4.text: Loop? What loop? Man, you guys never change.

b_again.text: Jay?! Two Jays?! What... wait. Have we done this before?

b_core.text: The big one's past the cave-in. Deep down. Moe wants it bad.

b_core2.text: Nobody's been past those rocks in years. You'd need dynamite. And a lantern. Trust me. Bring a lantern.

j_bobship.text: Come with us, Bob. There's a ship. We're getting off this planet.

b_ship.text: A way off this rock? I'm in. I'll hide out with that crazy old prospector till you're ready.

j2_final1.text: Here they come! All of them!

gp_gideon.text: Step away from the ship, boys. Or this one gets a new hole in his head.

gp_lucky.text: Sorry, partner. Gideon pays better than Moe. Step away from that ship.

gp_abe.text: Don't. Don't make me do this, son. Step away from the ship.

gp_amos.text: Forgive me, child. Gideon said he'd burn my church. Step away.

j_watch.text: Okay! Okay. Take the watch. Just let him go.

gp_watch.text: The watch? Ha! Thank you kindly.

j_talkdown.text: You don't have to do this. Put it down.

g_final.text: Well, well. Two little strangers, and a ship that shouldn't exist.

b_last1.text: Heh... told you... bring a lantern...

b_last2.text: Get off this rock, Jay. Both of you. For me.

m_reveal1.text: [laughs] Surprised, boys? Who'd you think paid for that roof?

m_reveal2.text: Every night, this town begs me for whiskey. Every night, I take what I want. And now I'll take your ship.

m_duel.text: Let's do this proper. On three.

j2_go.text: It's over. Jay. Let's go home.

j2_watch.text: Jay... your watch. What is it doing?

j_watch2.text: I don't know! It's... it's breaking everything!
